 """Repository interfaces and in-memory implementation."""
 
 from __future__ import annotations
 
 from typing import Protocol
 
 from core.models import CustomerOutcome, Job, Outcome, Step
 
 
 class Repository(Protocol):
     def add_job(self, job: Job) -> Job: ...
     def list_jobs(self) -> list[Job]: ...
     def get_job(self, job_id: str) -> Job | None: ...
+    def update_job(self, job_id: str, updates: dict) -> Job | None: ...
+    def delete_job(self, job_id: str) -> bool: ...
     def add_step(self, step: Step) -> Step: ...
+    def get_step(self, step_id: str) -> Step | None: ...
     def get_steps_for_job(self, job_id: str) -> list[Step]: ...
+    def update_step(self, step_id: str, updates: dict) -> Step | None: ...
+    def delete_step(self, step_id: str) -> bool: ...
     def add_outcome(self, outcome: Outcome) -> Outcome: ...
+    def get_outcome(self, outcome_id: str) -> Outcome | None: ...
     def get_outcomes(self, job_id: str, step_id: str | None = None) -> list[Outcome]: ...
+    def update_outcome(self, outcome_id: str, updates: dict) -> Outcome | None: ...
+    def delete_outcome(self, outcome_id: str) -> bool: ...
     def add_customer_outcome(self, co: CustomerOutcome) -> CustomerOutcome: ...
     def get_customer_outcome(self, outcome_id: str) -> CustomerOutcome | None: ...
     def list_customer_outcomes(self, job_id: str | None = None) -> list[CustomerOutcome]: ...
     def update_customer_outcome(self, outcome_id: str, updates: dict) -> CustomerOutcome | None: ...
     def delete_customer_outcome(self, outcome_id: str) -> bool: ...
     def clear(self) -> None: ...
 
 
 class InMemoryRepository:
     def __init__(self) -> None:
         self.jobs: dict[str, Job] = {}
         self.steps: dict[str, Step] = {}
         self.outcomes: dict[str, Outcome] = {}
         self.customer_outcomes: dict[str, CustomerOutcome] = {}
 
     def add_job(self, job: Job) -> Job:
         self.jobs[job.id] = job
         return job
 
     def list_jobs(self) -> list[Job]:
         return list(self.jobs.values())
 
     def get_job(self, job_id: str) -> Job | None:
         return self.jobs.get(job_id)
 
+    def update_job(self, job_id: str, updates: dict) -> Job | None:
+        job = self.jobs.get(job_id)
+        if not job:
+            return None
+        current = job.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
+        current.update(updates)
+        new_job = job.model_validate(current)
+        self.jobs[job_id] = new_job
+        return new_job
+
+    def delete_job(self, job_id: str) -> bool:
+        if job_id not in self.jobs:
+            return False
+        del self.jobs[job_id]
+        for key in [k for k, v in self.steps.items() if v.job_id == job_id]:
+            del self.steps[key]
+        for key in [k for k, v in self.outcomes.items() if v.job_id == job_id]:
+            del self.outcomes[key]
+        for key in [k for k, v in self.customer_outcomes.items() if v.job_id == job_id]:
+            del self.customer_outcomes[key]
+        return True
+
     def add_step(self, step: Step) -> Step:
         self.steps[step.id] = step
         return step
 
+    def get_step(self, step_id: str) -> Step | None:
+        return self.steps.get(step_id)
+
     def get_steps_for_job(self, job_id: str) -> list[Step]:
         return [s for s in self.steps.values() if s.job_id == job_id]
 
+    def update_step(self, step_id: str, updates: dict) -> Step | None:
+        step = self.steps.get(step_id)
+        if not step:
+            return None
+        current = step.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
+        current.update(updates)
+        new_step = step.model_validate(current)
+        self.steps[step_id] = new_step
+        return new_step
+
+    def delete_step(self, step_id: str) -> bool:
+        if step_id not in self.steps:
+            return False
+        del self.steps[step_id]
+        for key in [k for k, v in self.outcomes.items() if v.step_id == step_id]:
+            del self.outcomes[key]
+        for key in [k for k, v in self.customer_outcomes.items() if v.step_id == step_id]:
+            del self.customer_outcomes[key]
+        return True
+
     def add_outcome(self, outcome: Outcome) -> Outcome:
         self.outcomes[outcome.id] = outcome
         return outcome
 
+    def get_outcome(self, outcome_id: str) -> Outcome | None:
+        return self.outcomes.get(outcome_id)
+
     def get_outcomes(self, job_id: str, step_id: str | None = None) -> list[Outcome]:
         outs = [o for o in self.outcomes.values() if o.job_id == job_id]
         if step_id is not None:
             outs = [o for o in outs if o.step_id == step_id]
         return outs
 
+    def update_outcome(self, outcome_id: str, updates: dict) -> Outcome | None:
+        outcome = self.outcomes.get(outcome_id)
+        if not outcome:
+            return None
+        current = outcome.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
+        current.update(updates)
+        new_outcome = outcome.model_validate(current)
+        self.outcomes[outcome_id] = new_outcome
+        return new_outcome
+
+    def delete_outcome(self, outcome_id: str) -> bool:
+        if outcome_id in self.outcomes:
+            del self.outcomes[outcome_id]
+            return True
+        return False
+
     def add_customer_outcome(self, co: CustomerOutcome) -> CustomerOutcome:
         self.customer_outcomes[co.id] = co
         return co
 
     def get_customer_outcome(self, outcome_id: str) -> CustomerOutcome | None:
         return self.customer_outcomes.get(outcome_id)
 
     def list_customer_outcomes(self, job_id: str | None = None) -> list[CustomerOutcome]:
         if job_id is None:
             return list(self.customer_outcomes.values())
         return [co for co in self.customer_outcomes.values() if co.job_id == job_id]
 
     def update_customer_outcome(self, outcome_id: str, updates: dict) -> CustomerOutcome | None:
         co = self.customer_outcomes.get(outcome_id)
         if not co:
             return None
         current = co.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
         current.update(updates)
         new_co = co.model_validate(current)
         self.customer_outcomes[outcome_id] = new_co
         return new_co
 
     def delete_customer_outcome(self, outcome_id: str) -> bool:
         if outcome_id in self.customer_outcomes:
             del self.customer_outcomes[outcome_id]
             return True
         return False
 
     def clear(self) -> None:
         self.jobs.clear()
         self.steps.clear()
         self.outcomes.clear()
         self.customer_outcomes.clear()

+from core.models import (
+    BusinessImpactCategory,
+    BusinessValue,
+    CustomerOutcome,
+    CustomerValue,
+    Direction,
+    Job,
+    Outcome,
+    Step,
+)
+from core.repository import InMemoryRepository
+
+
+def _repo_with_graph() -> InMemoryRepository:
+    repo = InMemoryRepository()
+    repo.add_job(Job(id="j1", name="Job"))
+    repo.add_step(Step(id="s1", job_id="j1", name="Step", order=1))
+    repo.add_outcome(Outcome(id="o1", job_id="j1", step_id="s1", statement="Min x"))
+    return repo
+
+
+def _customer_outcome(id: str, job_id: str, step_id: str | None = None) -> CustomerOutcome:
+    return CustomerOutcome(
+        id=id,
+        job_id=job_id,
+        step_id=step_id,
+        customer_value=CustomerValue(
+            direction=Direction.MINIMIZE,
+            unit_of_measure="minutes",
+            object_of_control="support team",
+            statement="Minimize resolution time",
+            importance=9.0,
+            satisfaction=3.0,
+        ),
+        business_value=BusinessValue(
+            category=BusinessImpactCategory.COST_REDUCTION,
+            statement="Reduce support cost",
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+def test_get_step_and_get_outcome():
+    repo = _repo_with_graph()
+    assert repo.get_step("s1").name == "Step"  # type: ignore[union-attr]
+    assert repo.get_outcome("o1").statement == "Min x"  # type: ignore[union-attr]
+    assert repo.get_step("missing") is None
+
+
+def test_update_job_merges_and_returns_none_when_missing():
+    repo = _repo_with_graph()
+    updated = repo.update_job("j1", {"name": "Renamed"})
+    assert updated is not None and updated.name == "Renamed"
+    assert repo.update_job("nope", {"name": "x"}) is None
+
+
+def test_delete_job_cascades_dependents():
+    repo = _repo_with_graph()
+    assert repo.delete_job("j1") is True
+    assert repo.get_job("j1") is None
+    assert repo.get_step("s1") is None
+    assert repo.get_outcome("o1") is None
+    assert repo.delete_job("j1") is False
+
+
+def test_delete_step_cascades_its_outcomes():
+    repo = _repo_with_graph()
+    repo.add_outcome(Outcome(id="o2", job_id="j1", statement="Unbound"))
+    assert repo.delete_step("s1") is True
+    assert repo.get_step("s1") is None
+    assert repo.get_outcome("o1") is None
+    assert repo.get_outcome("o2") is not None
+
+
+def test_update_step_and_update_outcome_merge_or_return_none():
+    repo = _repo_with_graph()
+    updated_step = repo.update_step("s1", {"name": "Renamed step"})
+    assert updated_step is not None and updated_step.name == "Renamed step"
+    updated_outcome = repo.update_outcome("o1", {"statement": "Max y"})
+    assert updated_outcome is not None and updated_outcome.statement == "Max y"
+    assert repo.update_step("nope", {"name": "x"}) is None
+    assert repo.update_outcome("nope", {"statement": "x"}) is None
+
+
+def test_delete_outcome_and_delete_step_return_false_when_missing():
+    repo = _repo_with_graph()
+    assert repo.delete_outcome("nope") is False
+    assert repo.delete_step("nope") is False
+    assert repo.delete_outcome("o1") is True
+    assert repo.get_outcome("o1") is None
+
+
+def test_delete_job_cascades_customer_outcomes():
+    repo = _repo_with_graph()
+    repo.add_customer_outcome(_customer_outcome("co1", job_id="j1", step_id="s1"))

+    assert repo.delete_job("j1") is True

from core.models import (
    BusinessImpactCategory,
    BusinessValue,
    CustomerOutcome,
    CustomerValue,
    Direction,
    Job,
    Outcome,
    Step,
)
from core.repository import InMemoryRepository


def _repo_with_graph() -> InMemoryRepository:
    repo = InMemoryRepository()
    repo.add_job(Job(id="j1", name="Job"))
    repo.add_step(Step(id="s1", job_id="j1", name="Step", order=1))
    repo.add_outcome(Outcome(id="o1", job_id="j1", step_id="s1", statement="Min x"))
    return repo


def _customer_outcome(id: str, job_id: str, step_id: str | None = None) -> CustomerOutcome:
    return CustomerOutcome(
        id=id,
        job_id=job_id,
        step_id=step_id,
        customer_value=CustomerValue(
            direction=Direction.MINIMIZE,
            unit_of_measure="minutes",
            object_of_control="support team",
            statement="Minimize resolution time",
            importance=9.0,
            satisfaction=3.0,
        ),
        business_value=BusinessValue(
            category=BusinessImpactCategory.COST_REDUCTION,
            statement="Reduce support cost",
        ),
    )


def test_get_step_and_get_outcome():
    repo = _repo_with_graph()
    assert repo.get_step("s1").name == "Step"  # type: ignore[union-attr]
    assert repo.get_outcome("o1").statement == "Min x"  # type: ignore[union-attr]
    assert repo.get_step("missing") is None


def test_update_job_merges_and_returns_none_when_missing():
    repo = _repo_with_graph()
    updated = repo.update_job("j1", {"name": "Renamed"})
    assert updated is not None and updated.name == "Renamed"
    assert repo.update_job("nope", {"name": "x"}) is None


def test_delete_job_cascades_dependents():
    repo = _repo_with_graph()
    assert repo.delete_job("j1") is True
    assert repo.get_job("j1") is None
    assert repo.get_step("s1") is None
    assert repo.get_outcome("o1") is None
    assert repo.delete_job("j1") is False


def test_delete_step_cascades_its_outcomes():
    repo = _repo_with_graph()
    repo.add_outcome(Outcome(id="o2", job_id="j1", statement="Unbound"))
    assert repo.delete_step("s1") is True
    assert repo.get_step("s1") is None
    assert repo.get_outcome("o1") is None
    assert repo.get_outcome("o2") is not None


def test_update_step_and_update_outcome_merge_or_return_none():
    repo = _repo_with_graph()
    updated_step = repo.update_step("s1", {"name": "Renamed step"})
    assert updated_step is not None and updated_step.name == "Renamed step"
    updated_outcome = repo.update_outcome("o1", {"statement": "Max y"})
    assert updated_outcome is not None and updated_outcome.statement == "Max y"
    assert repo.update_step("nope", {"name": "x"}) is None
    assert repo.update_outcome("nope", {"statement": "x"}) is None


def test_delete_outcome_and_delete_step_return_false_when_missing():
    repo = _repo_with_graph()
    assert repo.delete_outcome("nope") is False
    assert repo.delete_step("nope") is False
    assert repo.delete_outcome("o1") is True
    assert repo.get_outcome("o1") is None


def test_delete_job_cascades_customer_outcomes():
    repo = _repo_with_graph()
    repo.add_customer_outcome(_customer_outcome("co1", job_id="j1", step_id="s1"))
    repo.add_customer_outcome(_customer_outcome("co2", job_id="other"))
    assert repo.delete_job("j1") is True
    assert repo.get_customer_outcome("co1") is None
    assert repo.get_customer_outcome("co2") is not None


def test_delete_step_cascades_customer_outcomes():
    repo = _repo_with_graph()
    repo.add_customer_outcome(_customer_outcome("co1", job_id="j1", step_id="s1"))
    repo.add_customer_outcome(_customer_outcome("co2", job_id="j1"))
    assert repo.delete_step("s1") is True
    assert repo.get_customer_outcome("co1") is None
    assert repo.get_customer_outcome("co2") is not None
